result.question: Quais os 10 motivos mais comuns de internação para pacientes indígenas?
result.gold_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."RACA_COR" = 5 GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS motivo_internacao, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."RACA_COR" = 5 GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
